'''Felstun's Transfer Cable Bar''' was a drinking establishment. The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] [[Skerrit]] and [[Tosha]] met in the bar to discuss transporting a cargo of [[bandara]] to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].<ref name="COTG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
